=segments.text: Mika’s lance flared silver. "Now, commander—"
"Hold!" Geralt’s voice cut steel.
The vine tightened around Ren’s throat. Emerald veins pulsed. Node Gamma leaned in—a hunter savoring surrender.
Oreck’s arrow trembled. Halvar’s breath roared.

In the suffocating quiet, Geralt’s Applicator flickered once:  
> PARASITE ATTENTION THRESHOLD: 98%  
> READY—
The root lunged.

Ren’s choked gasp echoed through the emitters—amplified into a shriek that shattered Mika’s shield-wall. Acidic sap rained down as vines erupted from the fissure. Geralt drove Luminara into the soil. Her golden light flared—not against the root, but *through* it. Node Gamma’s core pulsed crimson where Ren’s stolen memories bled. The parasite had consumed suffering. Now it choked on hope.

Halvar moved first. Not toward the monster, but sideways—his axe carving sigils into stone Oreck had marked hours earlier. Martian ward-runes flared emerald. Vines recoiled as ancestral geometry scorched their false flesh. The distraction lasted seconds. Long enough.

Oreck loosed his arrow. Not at the core, but into the soil where Node Gamma’s roots drank deep. Chroniton energy bloomed downward—a temporal anchor dragging the parasite toward its own creation moment. The monster shuddered. Emitters spat static. For a heartbeat, Geralt saw it: the Anunnaki drill biting into virgin earth fifteen years past. The root *remembered* being a weapon.

Then the memory curdled. Gold-green veins thickened, swallowing the chroniton pulse. Node Gamma learned—adapting its resonance to mimic Oreck’s armor frequency. The dissonance slammed Geralt to his knees. Luminara’s light fractured. Shadows deepened.
A vine wrapped Mika’s throat. Another pinned Halvar’s axe-arm. Ren sobbed as roots pried open his mind, mining fresh despair.

Geralt’s Applicator burned:  
> PARASITE ADAPTATION RATE EXCEEDING TOLERANCES  
> COUNTERMEASURE: RESONANT SACRIFICE? Y/
He didn’t hesitate.
Standing, he ripped the Applicator from his temple. Blood streamed down his cheek as he pressed the scorching metal to Luminara’s haft. "Take it all," he whispered. Not command. Invitation.

The relic blazed—feeding on his pain, his doubt, the weight of every Legionnaire’s scream. Her light shifted from gold to blinding white. Node Gamma recoiled, emitters overloading as pure, unfiltered humanity flooded its circuits.
For the first time, the jungle screamed—not imitation, but agony.
Mika gasped free. Halvar roared.
Above them, wings dove through the canopy—too fast, too late.
Oreck nocked his last arrow.
The root twitched—not in retreat, but anticipation. Learning again. Always learning.

The blinding white light seared Geralt’s vision, throbbing against Node Gamma’s corrupted heart. Acidic sap hissed where it struck vines, vaporizing into acrid clouds that stung the Legionnaires’ throats. Through the glare, Geralt glimpsed the parasite’s core pulsing faster—not overwhelmed, but analyzing. Absorbing. Its gold-green veins flared brighter, synchronizing with Luminara’s desperate resonance.

Ren crumpled to his knees, clutching his temples. "It’s inside my skull," he choked. "Counting my breaths." The root echoed him perfectly: a thousand whispering vines replicating each ragged gasp. Mika’s shield flickered back to life, silver light straining against the cognitive tide. Halvar swung his axe—not at the root, but at the rune-carved earth. Martian glyphs flared emerald beneath its twisting tendrils. Stone groaned instead of screaming. A distraction.

Oreck didn’t flinch. His arrow’s chroniton tip hummed with stolen time—the spark before impact. He aimed low, beneath the root’s armored segments, toward threads binding it to the deeper network. "Feeding tube," he hissed. Geralt nodded, blood dripping from his temple onto Luminara’s haft. The relic drank it greedily, light wavering between white and sickly gold-green imitation. Parasite logic adapted. Patience wore thin.

Above, wings shredded the canopy. Reptilian scouts descended in silence, claws extended not for flesh, but for the fractured shield-dome. Their scales vibrated with the jungle’s stolen chorus—Halvar’s guilt, Ren’s terror, Oreck’s faith—amplified into weapons. Mika met them with lance raised, her defiance a raw scream swallowed by dissonance.

Senareth’s voice slithered through the roots once more: *All gardens end*. Geralt tightened his grip. "Not yet." Luminara pulsed—a final, searing note of pure defiance. Node Gamma shuddered, emitters flaring crimson. For a heartbeat, its song fractured into static. Silence.
Then the serpentine root lunged—not at Geralt, but at Oreck’s drawn bow. Learning. Always learning.

Emerald light met gold-green corruption. Oreck’s chroniton arrow shattered mid-flight, spraying temporal shards that froze vines like glass. Halvar roared, axe cleaving through petrified thorns. But Node Gamma didn’t bleed; it absorbed. Fractal patterns bloomed where steel struck, replicating Halvar’s rage into razor-edged bark. Ren stumbled backward as the ground itself mirrored his panic—soil liquefying beneath his boots.

Mika’s lance flashed silver. "Shield-wall failing!" she gasped. Reptilian scouts raked claws against the dome, their scales vibrating with stolen despair. The shield flickered, thinned by Ren’s amplified whimpers. Acidic rain ate through armor joints. Stench of burnt wiring and rotting lilacs choked the air.

Geralt staggered. Luminara’s white glare dimmed as Node Gamma fed on her resonance—gold-green veins pulsing in perfect sync with her fading light. The parasite wasn’t fighting; it was *digesting*. His Applicator, discarded and bloody, blinked a final warning: > ADAPTATION COMPLETE. COUNTER-RESONANCE IMMINENT.
Then came the hum.
Deeper than the jungle’s stolen chorus. Older.

From the fissure, Node Gamma’s core split open. Not a maw, but a conduit. A beam of condensed anguish—Ren’s Martian ghosts, Halvar’s buried shame, Oreck’s crumbling faith—lanced toward Geralt. Luminara flared gold-green in reply, her light buckling under the weight of their own poisoned memories. Geralt’s knees hit mud. Stone teeth closed around his ankles.
Silence.
Senareth’s voice, faint as root-sap: *Remember the mountain.*
Geralt’s hand found the earth. Not fighting. Feeling.
Beneath Node Gamma’s false song, the true planet thrummed—a slow, pained heartbeat. Tiamat’s scar, buried deep. The First Garden’s wound.
He let go.
Luminara’s light died. Darkness swallowed the clearing.
Node Gamma shuddered—starved of its reflection. Confused.
In that void, Geralt whispered Tiamat’s true name.
The ground answered.
Not with roar, but sigh. Ancient vrill surged through the soil, searing gold-green veins black. Node Gamma screamed—a raw, mechanical shriek untouched by stolen souls.
Above, wings faltered. The shield-dome flared pure silver.
Dawn’s first light pierced the canopy.
It found them broken. Bleeding.

Alive, perhaps. But nowhere near safe. The dawn light filtering through the shattered canopy illuminated horrors reshaped. Where Node Gamma had writhed, obsidian roots now rose like twisted sculptures—frozen mid-thrash, veins charred black by Earth's cleansing surge. The memory-stench of Senareth's voice lingered like ozone after lightning, fading into the wet hum of wounded jungle. Legionnaires stumbled through steaming mud, dragging comrades whose armor hissed with residual dissonance. Halvar spat crimson phlegm, his axe embedded in petrified bark that still wept violet sap. Mika leaned against Ren, whose haunted eyes scanned every shuddering fern. Oreck’s fingers brushed the fractured altar stone—still faintly warm where primal vrill had seared Anunnaki corruption away. "That sigh," he rasped. "It wasn't victory. It was exhaustion."

Geralt’s neural link screamed static where the Applicator had been. Ghost diagnostics flared behind his eyelids: phantom warnings about residual synaptic decay. Luminara lay cold as glacier ice against his hip, her usual hum replaced by a fragile silence. *The Garden remembers pain*, she’d said. Now, it remembered silence too. Lyra’s scanner chirped weakly, projecting a scarred map onto slick basalt. Violet resonance threads still pulsed slow poison beneath their boots—distant nodes compensating. "Safe zone?" Mika pleaded. Lyra traced a crack spiderwebbing down the pyramid’s flank. "Here. For now. Deep foundations fractured the corruption. Like… scar tissue."

Halvar punched through a lattice of calcified vines guarding the entrance. Inside, the air tasted of dry dust and forgotten incense, a startling reprieve from the jungle’s decaying sweetness. Moonstone inscriptions spiraled up obsidian walls—pristine Earth-script untouched by parasitic tech’s violet bloom. Geralt collapsed onto a stone bench, his bloodied palm pressed against the wall. The cold seeped in, soothing the phantom burn of Luminara’s sacrifice. Ren crumpled beside him, trembling fingers tracing blade-nicks in his thigh plate. "Dropped it," he whispered. "When… when she mimicked Mars." Halvar grunted, wrenching cages open—not Igigi prisoners, but empty iron husks clinking faintly. "They broke free," Mika realized. "During the scream." Her lance tip glowed soft silver, bathing the chamber in gentle light. For a breath, only the drip of condensation echoed. Safe. Or its cruel imitation.

Oreck crouched by a mural carved deep into the rear wall. Not Anunnaki gods, but Terra Fist legionnaires planting vrill-seeds into fertile earth. Their helmets were off, faces weary but smiling under a sun Geralt barely remembered. Lyra’s scanner flickered over the stone. "Pure resonance signature. Pre-war. A… sanctuary?" The hum here was different—deeper, slower. Healing. Geralt closed his eyes, feeling the stone’s faint pulse against his spine. Luminara stirred. Not with light, but warmth. *Anchor… holding…* Geralt’s fingers brushed Ren’s shoulder. "Breathe," he murmured. Beyond the entrance, reptilian horns blared—distant, furious. Roots still choked the world. But here, beneath forgotten stone, silence pooled thick and heavy. Not peace. Respite. Halvar braced his axe against the doorframe, grinning at the shadows outside. "Rest while it lasts," he rumbled. Outside, rain hissed like acid. Inside, the mural’s sun glowed faintly gold.

Lyra counted aloud in the gloom, her scanner casting spectral blue light across bruised faces. "Two hundred Eighteen Legionnaires accounted for." Voice thinning"Seven walking wounded."  Mika knelt beside Voros's scorched chestplate—laid against the wall like a grave marker. Halvar spat on stone. "Fell shielding Ren at Node Gamma." Silence pooled thickly. Geralt recalled Voros—barrel-chested, laughing as he planted Martian flags among ruins. Snuffed out whispering vines crushing his throat. Their names echoed against murals showing wheat fields under blue skies. A ghostly tally.

Ren shuddered against Geralt's leg armor. Blood seeped through his temple-bandage from where parasitic resonance spikes had driven deep. "They used Voros's laughter," he whispered. "Made it sound like mockery." Mika's fingers tightened on her lance. "Yesterday's ambush near the Altar Ruins. Today Node Gamma." Fragments clicked—Reptilian claws shredding through shieldwalls, roots twisting underfoot, Senareth's taunting truths. How many skirmishes since Mars? Time blurred under poisoned skies. Halvar jammed his axe into a crack. "Lost Grishka yesterday. Igigi traps opened beneath him." Lyra nodded grimly. "Her vitals flatlined before the Node Gamma assault." The chamber felt smaller. The Garden's toll grew teeth.

Oreck's voice rasped from the mural's shadow. "Not just losses." He held up a fractured Igigi control collar—snapped during the parasite's scream. "The prisoners broke free. All six." A sliver of triumph. Geralt remembered cages rattling as roots recoiled. Halvar snorted. "Ran deep into thorns. Hope lasts ten breaths out there." Mika traced her lance's silver sigil. "Luminara bled white light into that root. Broke Senareth's voice." The mural's stone fists seemed to clench. Sacrifices scored into stone: Voros's shield, Grishka's fall, Geralt's Applicator fused with Luminara.

Outside, a reptilian shriek pierced the rain. Close. Legionnaires stirred, hands finding blades. Halvar eased his axe free. "Rest wont come easy" Geralt touched Luminara's cold haft. "Get what we can, we head out at first light" mika nods "I'll take the first watch"

The humid silence shattered before dawn. Scrabbling claws echoed down the outer corridor—too light for Reptilian scales. A ragged silhouette stumbled into the sanctuary’s archway. Barefoot, bleeding from thorn-gouges, one of the freed Igigi prisoners swayed beneath crumbling moonstone carvings. His chest heaved, eyes wide with residual terror. Behind him, five others pressed close like hunted animals, their stolen rags soaked in mud and something darker. Not triumphant escapees. Survivors.

The lead Igigi collapsed against Mika’s shield-brace. "They hunt… still hunt," he gasped, clutching a snapped vrill-collar fused to his wrist. "Thorn-traps… whispering roots…" His words dissolved into wet coughs. Lyra’s scanner confirmed—no trackers, no parasites. Only exhaustion and acid-burns blooming across their skin. Halvar hauled him upright, scanning the corridor’s dripping gloom. "Scouts?"

"Lost… three in the ferns," another prisoner whispered, trembling fingers tracing glyphs on her thigh—ancient wards against memory-theft. "Serpentor’s brood… they taste fear now. Like Senareth." Recognition sparked in Ren’s haunted gaze. These weren’t warriors. They were farmers once, their calloused palms proof against the mural’s carved plowshares.

Geralt gestured to Legion medics. Bandages hissed against acid-eaten skin. Oreck offered water flasks, his eyes lingering on their snapped collars. One prisoner flinched away—the echo of Anunnaki control still twitching in her nerves. "We tried to hide," she murmured, staring at Voros’s chestplate against the wall. "But the jungle… it breathes where you stand." Her hand brushed Ren’s blood-crusted bandage. Shared scars. Mika locked shields at the entrance, lance humming low silver. Dawn light crept closer, greying the vines beyond the arch. Respite ending. The Garden tightening its grip.

Above the mural’s carved sun, obsidian cracks bled violet light. Distant thunder mocked their fleeting sanctuary. Halvar tested his axe-edge. "Grafting deeper," he grunted. Geralt felt Luminara stir—not warming, but resonating with the deeper stone pulse. Anchor holding. For now. The freed ones huddled near Ren, drawing strength from his quivering stillness. Legion and former prisoner. Chains broken. Roots still digging.

One Igigi elder—skin mapped with scars that mirrored cracked earth—raised shaking hands. His name was Borin. He pressed palms flat against the mural’s fertile soil. Eyes closed. Silent. The deep hum beneath their feet intensified. Lyra’s scanner flared: *Resonance Synchronicity Detected*. Mika hissed sharply. Ghrel, another farmer, traced glyphs onto his forearm. *"Weavers,"* Borin breathed. *"Earth-Giants slept beneath these peaks... before Anunnaki silenced them with stolen song."* Not myth. Memory etched in blood-grit under fingernails.

Oreck’s salvaged armor flickered—emerald light bleeding through seams. He knelt beside Borin. "Giants used vrill-lines?" Borin’s nod was a tremor. *"Bone-deep harmony. Their breath shaped mountains."* Geralt recalled fragments from Luminaire’s fading song—Tiamat’s true name had anchored Earth’s pulse. Silence wasn’t surrender. It was waiting.

Halvar snarled at the bleeding violet cracks above. Reptilian horns echoed. Close. Too close. "Giants won’t wake for whispers!" Borin touched Ghrel’s glyphs. *"Harmonies broken... jagged edges. Need resonance... pure pain... pure hope..."* His gaze locked on Ren’s bandaged temple—the psychic wound pulsing crimson. On Geralt’s scarred palm where Luminara lay dormant. On Mika’s silver lance. On Oreck’s humming armor. Sacrifice. Fury. Endurance. Fragments of a whole. *"A bridge,"* Ghrel rasped. *"With Legion souls... as tuning fork."* Legionnaires shifted. Not weapons. Instruments.

Dawn’s grey light bled through the entrance vines. Mika formed the shield-wall flanking the corridor—a shimmering silver barricade against encroaching shadows. Reptilian scouts scaled the pyramid’s flank, claws rasping as they tasted fractured resonance. Geralt pressed Borin’s hand against the mural’s stone sun. *"Show us."* The Igigi elder closed bloodshot eyes. Senareth’s mocking truths still echoed—but Borin’s roots sank past corruption. Into deep bedrock. Into silence that remembered Giants.

Ghrel linked hands with Ren, whose terror-thinned aura pulsed discordant gold-green. *"Still yourself,"* Ghrel murmured. *"Breathe the buried hum."* Ren shuddered, veins straining. Lyra’s scanner flashed crimson—parasite resonance attempting re-entry. Mika’s lance surged silver. *Hold.* Oreck pressed his armored palm against Ren’s shoulder. Emerald light flared, stabilizing fractured air. Halvar crouched, axe braced—guardian against distraction. Legionnaires locked shoulders—their collective breath syncing with Ghrel’s desperate chant.

Borin’s scarred palms glowed faint bronze where they touched stone. The mural vibrated. Geralt poured Luminara’s cold echo into the contact. Dissonance screamed—Ren’s pain and Reptilian screeches clawing at focus. Borin gasped, tendons standing stark. *"Sing!"* Legionnaires roared—not a war-cry, but harmonic resonance keyed to Borin’s internalized earth-song. Oreck’s armor amplified it. The mural’s carved legionnaires blurred—gold light bleeding into stone. Down. Down.

Deep beneath corrupted roots, granite stirred. Not thunder. A sigh. Centuries deep. Violet cracks in the ceiling sealed abruptly. Halvar grinned ferally as Reptilian cries twisted to panic. Ghrel sagged. Ren breathed clean air for the first time in days. *"They hear..."* Borin whispered. Above, the jungle fell silent. Listening. Beyond Mika’s shield-wall, acidic rain ceased. Stone groaned—the sound of mountains shifting position in sleep. Distance fractured. Paths unseen opened in writhing thorns. One led toward jagged peaks. Toward Giants. Toward alliance forged in shared defiance. Legion and Igigi locked eyes. Roots trembled. Not digging. Awakening.

The journey became a descent into Earth’s wounded core. Vrill-lines pulsed beneath their boots, guiding them through hidden channels carved by Giants millennia past. Borin walked ahead, scarred hands brushing rough tunnel walls coated in phosphorescent moss, humming notes Geralt couldn’t replicate. Arches drowned in roots recoiled, clearing paths. Sections of corrupted vines shriveled before them. Deep pulsing rhythm echoed against Geralt’s ribs. Lyra’s scanner displayed streams of harmonic energy converging beneath distant peaks—the Giants’ slumbering power source.

Geralt touched Luminara’s dormant surface. *Common ground.* Not weapons or pleas. Shared resonance. Earth’s agony channeled through Legion sacrifice—Halvar’s rage-forged endurance, Ren’s fractured resolve. Oreck’s armor emitted emerald light, harmonizing with Ghrel’s glyphs. Mika’s shield flared brighter as she walked beside Borin. Above ground, Reptilian horns sounded frantic, lost. The deeper they descended, the clearer the Giant’s deep breathing grew, vibrating through stone. The Garden itself became their ally.

At a cavernous fork, Borin paused. Before them spanned a chasm glowing with molten gold light—the Giants’ cradle. Obsidian cliffs rose impossibly high. Across the void, shadows moved—vast, slow shapes coalescing from rockfall dust. One titanic head lifted. Eyes like cooled magma stared down. Silence. Then, a voice like grinding continents: *"Why disturb the silence?"* Borin stepped onto the ledge. He raised Geralt’s hand. Luminara remained cold. He touched Ren’s temple-scar. Halvar’s axe-gouged knuckles. Mika’s silver lance. Oreck’s humming armor. Not defiance offered. Suffering acknowledged. Resonance rippled across the chasm. The Giant leaned closer. Stone groaned. *"Show me."* Behind them, vines choked the tunnel entrance shut. Reptilian screams echoed. Distant. Desperate.

The Dragonmail armor creaked against Geralt’s chest. Inside, cold fire—Aaon’s instinctive rejection. Deeper, the Applicator uncoiled. Bliss whispers slithered past conscious thought: *Give the Heartstone! Let them drown!* Geralt’s palm flared dark violet. A sickness-spot. The pain focused him. He raised the cracked Heartstone not to the Giant—but toward the clogged tunnel behind. Tart-acid stench thickened. Black ichor dripped down moss. Glowing eyes blinked in fetid shadow. *"Yes,"* rumbled the Giant. *"The rot sings louder."* Borin’s knees trembled. The mountain itself leaned forward breath-hot air thick with millennia-old sorrow. Giant palms unfurled. Stone scraped. They awaited an answer held not in words—but scents. Poison musk. Legion steel-stink. Luminara’s ozone spark. The Heartstone’s leaking sweetness. Muur’s rancid bile. Bone-deep rot.

Geralt’s stare cut through mist. Baleful green fungus pulsed on stalactites—breathing. Xul’Zaraan’s scorpion-bone key hummed against his ribs. Deafened. Safe. Hidden. Where Giants saw poisoned earth—he saw arteries. The Applicator twisted inward—drunk on Giant-fear pheromones. Tensile. Hungry. Aaon Keeper armor cooled—warning. Anxious thoughts tangled. Luminare’s resonance throbbed—needling bone. Thorin’s axe scraped tile. Borin gagged—wetness between stone cracks. Giant fingers drummed stone. Four beats. Drumbeat. Drumbeat. Drumbeat. Drumbeat. Borin’s leather jerkin wept condensation. The Applicator hissed—*Feed me!*

Muur’s voice growled—grave-soil deep. *"Swamp-Witch bartered you—worm."* Rock ground—a shrug. *"But rot deepens."* Stalagmite snapped. Thorin flinched. Muur sniffed—inspecting Geralt’s left palm. Luminare flared—light slicing fungal miasma. Giants grunted—half-blinded. Muur chuckled—soundwaves shaking wet earth loose. *"Light-Thief."* Stone knuckles brushed Geralt’s shoulder—deliberate. Muur inhaled—long—deep. Air whistled through nostrils—analyzing symbiotic signatures. Applicator stirred—fascinated. Dragonmail warmed—protective. Luminare dimmed—sickened. Muur leaned closer—stalactite breath. *"One poison fights another. Does that cleanse?"* Thorin’s hand slipped—dagger clattering. Borin gasped. Muur ignored—captivated. Eyes narrowed—black pits reflecting Geralt’s violet-tainted glow.

Geralt’s knuckles whitened around Heartstone cracks. Leaking Vril traced nerves—hot needles. Giant breath steamed chestplate—condensation dripping. Thorin’s boots slid—ice-grease slick. Borin’s teeth clicked—sudden chill. Muur’s grin widened—stone grinding stone. *"We watch."* Stone fingers gestured—detached. *"Play thief-games."* Eyes lifted—starving—toward Light-Shard veins above. *"Feed rot."* Rock shifted—darkness deepening. Borin whimpered—ankle-deep water lapping. Thorin cursed—slick footing. Drip. Drip. Drip. Muur’s gaze pinned Geralt—unblinking. *"Give poison."* Palm opened—a chasm. Distant—deep in mountain—glass needles screamed.

---
Geralt staggered—Impact-hum. Chestplate surged—electric-blue. LightShard snapped—skyward. Drawing…drawing…a liquid gravity. Breath caught—ice-taste—lungs crushed. Feet anchored—skidding. Bone-key fell—sizzling water. Muur laughed—sound like avalanches. Thorin shouted—lost. Borin scrambled—blind. LightShard pulsed—blinding—monument crumbling. Geralt’s gaze locked—Muur’s throat—something peeling—skin tearing—a glint—silver-mesh. *"Singers lie!"* Geralt roared—forced through LightShard pull—toward Muur—toward the glint—toward—

---
Silence. Heartstone burned—hand blistering. Muur frozen—skin flaking—silver-mesh throbbing—neck wound gaping. Borin’s dagger—buried—hilt-deep. Muur’s gasp—wet—drowning air. Thorin’s eyes—wide—understanding dawning. *"Skin-singer!"* Thorin spat—spittle frozen midair. Stone giants shifted—roar building. Borin trembled—dagger twisted—yanked. Silver-mesh hissed—vapour rising—a scent—burnt ozone—decay. Muur’s eyes rolled—white—silver-mesh snapping—whip-lash. Geralt saw—the mesh—sinking—escaping—

---
Chaos. LightShard screamed—sudden vacuum. Giants surged—stone fists swinging. Thorin parried—axe screaming—sparks showering. Borin scrambled—dagger dripping silver. Geralt lunged—Heartstone-first—toward Borin’s dagger—toward escaping mesh. Chestplate roared—dragon-growl—altitude compensating. Bone-key vanished—swirlpool forming. LightShard beam—shifted—target acquired—silver-mesh. Muur’s corpse—dematerializing—grey ash swirling. *"Portal!"* Thorin bellowed. Borin stumbled—sucking vortex. Geralt caught—Borin’s wrist—Heartstone flaring. Silver-mesh coiled—dagger shank—poised—to leap—into vortex—into—

LightShard’s pull intensified—a hurricane focused. Thorin’s axe bit into cracking granite—anchoring. Borin screamed—arm wrenched near dislocation—as Geralt hauled him backward. Silver-mesh pulsed—dagger-blade vibrating—inches from the swirling vacuum. Luminara flared—not cleansing—but *containment*. Violet light lashed—seizing silver-mesh mid-leap—binding it to the dagger hilt. The mesh shrieked—high-frequency agony shredding ambient mist. Bone-key thrummed—vortex stabilized—but shrinking. Stone fists hammered Geralt’s shield-wall—Oreck buckled—emerald armor flickering under seismic impacts. Above—phosphorescent fungi hissed—collapsing—stalactites plunging—ice-shards underfoot.

Geralt’s Applicator hissed—*Kill it here! Now!*—feeding on mesh-panic. Aaon Keeper armor chilled—condensation freezing gauntlets—counter-signaling: *Preserve. Interrogate.* Thorin roared—axe hacking stone-fingers—rock-fragments pelting Borin’s face. Borin choked—blood-misted breath freezing—eyes locked on bound mesh. *"They wore us... like clothes..."* Ice-water surged—ankle-deep—rising fast. Heartstone pulsed—gold leaking into swirling water—countering vortex pull. Geralt pressed palm—Luminara cold—against Borin’s dagger. Mesh recoiled—silver tangling—desperate. Tunnel entrances—collapsing—giants retreating—roaring confusion. Vortex dimmed—shrinking—swirling gold-water thickening to gel.

Sudden silence. Vortex sealed—bone-key dark. Silver-mesh lay bound—quivering—dagger embedded in frozen gold-sludge. Thorin spat blood—knee-deep in ice-slush—scanning crumbling archways. Borin trembled—dagger-hilt clutched—mesh writhing against Luminara’s violet shackles. Oreck’s armor hissed—steam rising—geothermal vents erupting nearby. Distant giants—bellowed arguments—stone on stone. Geralt knelt—gauntlet hovering—above captive mesh. Applicator purred—*Consume its secrets.* Armor vibrated—warning—*Tether broken—hive mind alerted.* Heartstone crack—glowed—duller—leaking Vril mingling with thawing ice. Borin’s whisper—hoarse—*"Muur was puppet... but why reveal throat-seam?"* Mesh jerked—testing bonds—silver filaments probing Luminara’s light. A glint—buried deep—within tangled strands. Memory-core? Or trap?

Geralt’s scarred palm—lowered—toward mesh. Applicator surged—hunger sharpening senses—smelling hive-fear. Mesh recoiled—maximal strain—silver filaments snapping. Too late. Fingertips touched—cold metal—imbedded sliver. Vision erupted—sensory overload: *Orange dust-storms— Martian drill-site. Nine Star-Needles— humming— aligned. Eduhauana’s silhouette— amplified by poisoned Luminare resonance— directing... extraction? No. Injection. Vril-streams—reverse-flow— Earth-bound— carrying... spores. Viral seeds. Harvest-ready.* Heartstone pulsed—syncopated—pain-flash—breaking vision. Mesh convulsed—silver melting—dagger hilt scorching Borin’s grip. *"They’re seeding the Vril!"* Geralt gasped—ice-water biting thighs. Thorin cursed—axe raised—toward crumbling ceiling. Giants—silent now—listening. Borin’s eyes widened—understanding dawning—dagger trembling. Mesh dissolved—ash on thawing ice—message delivered. Purpose revealed. Countdown started.

Above—new sound. Not stone-collapse. Metallic screech—tearing mountain-flesh. Igigi horns—panicked—echoing through tunnels. "Annunaki drills!" Borin’s voice cracked. Thorin snarled—fresh blood-streaks on armored chestplate. Geralt clutched Heartstone—gold-leak brightening—answering distant drill-hum. Luminare pulsed—cold—sickened by Martian resonance. Applicator writhed—dazed—drunk on hive-image aftermath. Armor cooled—icy patches spreading—shielding Geralt’s mind. Choice crystallized: Cleanse Mars—purge poisoned source—stop seeding—or Earth dies. Giants stirred—massive forms shifting—dust-clouds rising. Distant howls—confused—angry. Thorin spat—ice shattering. "Stone-folk wake slow." Geralt’s gaze locked—deep cavern—where obsidian cliffs met molten gold. Giants’ eyes—glowing—met his—understanding kindling. Not alliance. Necessity.

Thorin’s axe-blade scraped runes—sudden—insistent. Stone-giant nearest—grunted. Recognition. Symbols flared—bronze-light—giant-carved. *Throne-path*. Borin gasped—dagger-hilt still steaming. "Old Ways... forgotten." Tunnel walls—phosphorescent moss—flowed—forming arrows—pointing... deeper. Toward heart-gold-pool. Vril-source. Giants shifted—clearing path—grudgingly. Drill-screeches intensified—vibrating bone—metal grinding bedrock. Oreck’s armor flashed—repair-glyphs activating—emerald light battling encroaching dark. Geralt stepped—forward—Heartstone raised—leak-intensified. Gold-lines leapt—connecting—pool-surge—giant-pulse—Legion-breath. Luminare answered—cold-light—meeting Martian poison-drone. Giant-roar erupted—approval? Or challenge? Pool-surface—rippled—not water. Liquid resonance. Portal? Amplifier? Thorin grinned—savage—ready. Borin whispered—dagger lowered—"Only Giants knew...". Drill-hum peaked—deafening—rock-screams. Geralt hesitated—edge of gold. Heartstone fragments—burning—whole purpose clear now: Not weapon. Catalyst. Sacrifice demanded. Applicator hissed—*Yes—feed me—into it—*. Armor vibrated—warning. Choice made. Geralt plunged—hand—Heartstone-first—into liquid light—toward poisoned stars.

Gold-light enveloped—thick—honey-slow. Skin burned—not heat—pressure—immense. Vril-currents pulsed—river-deep—carrying Martian echo—bitter-acid-taste—teeth-chattering cold. Geralt’s bones hummed—resonating—giant-song—deep—mournful. Heartstone shards—dissolving—gold-fire—racing veins—toward Luminare. Palm screamed—dark-violet corruption—fighting influx. Applicator surged—blissful agony—drinking pure Vril—processing poison—purifying? Twisting? Armor clamped—neck-guard tightening—breath forced—focus regained. Vision cleared—gold-pool depth. Beneath—not rock. Fractal lattice—glowing blue-white—Throne-path core—world-network. Nine dark-thorns—Star-Needles—embedded deep—reversed-flow—pumping Martian spores upward. Poisoning Earth-gold. Feeding Giants’ sickness. Giant-shapes surrounded pool-edge—silent watchers—massive silhouettes against phosphor-glow. Thorin’s roar—distant—axe striking stone—holding tunnel entrance against screeching drills. Oreck strained—shield-wall buckling—emerald darkening—under siege. Borin—dagger dripping silver-mesh ash—chanted—earth-song—amplifying Geralt’s anchor. Giant nearest—knelt—massive palm—lowered—toward pool-surface. Not attack. Offer. Join resonance. Cleansing song. *Now*, Luminare pulsed—cold-purifying-light—yearning. Applicator snarled—*Mine—first!*—drinking deeper—starving Luminare. Geralt roared—internal—downward thrust—deeper—forcing Heartstone-gold into lattice—toward nearest Needle-darkness. Martian scream—psychic backlash—hit.

Impact—mind-rending. Not sound—silence-shatter. Pool-surface—exploded upward—not liquid—hard-light shards—razor-fragments. Geralt’s shield—Oreck’s desperate emerald surge—flared—cracked. Light-shards sliced—chestplate screeched—dragon-scale deepened—scarlet lines. Blood—his? Legionnaire?—mist-copper scent. Thorin fell—knee-deep—goliath tremors. Borin’s chant—cut—choking—silver-ichor coughing. Giants stumbled—roaring confusion—pool-light gone chaotic—gold-black-strobe. Vision fragmented: Luminare—desperate violet-radiance—lashed—binding fractured gold-flow—containing backlash. Applicator—gleeful—feeding on Martian agony—virus-spores boiling near—repelled? Absorbed? Armor—locked joints—forcing Geralt upright—targeting. **There**. Heartstone remnants—glowing core—embedded lattice. Star-Needle’s dark-root—visible—pulsing sick-green—Martian origin-point. Drill-screech peaked—ceiling fractured—igneous rockfall—molten slag raining—Igigi horns triumphant—close. Too close. Giant palm—still hovering—trembling—ready. Geralt seized Heartstone-core—ignoring molten pain. Pull? Push? Amplify? Applicator hissed—*Transmit me—through it—to Mars—to hive-core!*. Luminare flared—denial—cleansing-wave focused—downward thrust—pure sound-light—toward Needle-root. Choices warred—symbiotes clashing—within Geralt’s grasp. Martian resonance—cold—calculating—answered—poisoned-light spear—upward thrust—to pierce heart-gold pool—erase interloper. Collision inevitable. Geralt braced—not shield—sacrifice. Palms met—Luminare—Heartstone-core—Applicator’s hunger—toward Needle-darkness—into Martian torrent. Fused. Released. Silence swallowed sound… then... detonation. White-gold-black. Oblivion light.

Geralt floated—limbless—silent—in void-dark. Debris—rock—armor—frozen mid-explosion. Borin’s dagger—silver-mesh ash—dissolving snowflake-slow. Thorin’s axe—buried shale—vibrating—residual shockwave. Gold-lattice—fractured—slow-motion collapse—blue-white sparks dying. Star-Needle-root—blackened—retracted? Withered? Martian backlash—gone. Echo remained—phantom drill-hum—fading. Cold—bone-deep—crept. Chestplate groaned—steel-stress fractures. Dragonmail twitched—palely—glow dimmed. Inside—Applicator purred—satiated—dream-drunk—Martian memories swirling—eduauhauana’s-patterns... harvesting… thresholds… Luminare pulsed—weak—fever-hot—palm blistering violet—still poisoned? Cleansed? Giants stirred—rubble-shift thunder—confused—awed? Hostile? Footsteps—heavy—approaching. Thorin’s voice—raw—scrapes echoing—"Commander?" Geralt couldn’t move. Frozen—not ice—psychic residue—collision aftermath. Vision tunnelled—downward—pool-bed. Lattice gone. Star-scar remained—obsidian wound—smoking. At its center—embedded shallow—small—gleaming—needle-fragment? Or new seed? Footsteps halted—giant-shadow fell—blotting phosphor-glare—silent—judging. Stone breath—dust-scented—stirred Geralt’s hair. Giant knelt—massive hand—descended—slow—not crushing—reaching… toward smoking scar… toward gleaming fragment… toward Geralt’s unmoving form. Intent unclear. Salvation? Claim? Thorin snarled—axe-haft creaking—ready leap—heedless debris-field. Borin gasped—dagger raised—pointless-defiance. Geralt’s Applicator sighed—*Let it take the prize…*. Armor chilled—neck-guard tightening—warning: *Betrayal imminent.* Luminare fluttered—palm-cooling—quiet—too quiet—exhausted. Giant fingers—inches away—rough-pebble touch imminent—destination—gleaming scar-fragment… or Geralt’s throat? Choice suspended—breath held—worlds hinged—on stone-giant’s grasp.

Giant fingertip—calloused stone—brushed obsidian scar-edge—not Geralt. Tremor—deep—ran mountain-core—pool-bed groaned—water seeped. Scar smoked—fresh—gold-core deep. Fragment gleamed—cold-silver—Star-Needle shard? Smaller—purer. Giant grunt—approval?—rough finger circled fragment—lifted—gentle—ash-fall soft. Dagger-sharp—sized giant-thumbnail—it pulsed blue-white—clean light—painting giant-stone purple-grey veins. Thorin eased—axe lowered—millimeter. Borin exhaled—fog-plume—dagger trembling. Giant examined—silver-shard—tipped—toward Geralt—offered. Not threat. Gift? Armor warmed—slightly—protective/threat assessment. Applicator stirred—*Pure… ungrateful… waste…*. Luminare brightened—violet-lens focused—shard-light—resonated—cleansing-song? Distant—above—drill-screech renewed—closer—hungrier—Igigi hunting signal—echoing shaft-collapse. Giants roared—panic—defiance—warning—too many meanings—chaos chorus. Thorin shouted—"Portals collapse!"—pointing—east tunnel—flowstone melted-glob—sealing path. Borin crawled—ice-sludge—toward Geralt—"Heartstone catalyst… consumed… pool blocked…" Giant—shard-carrier—stood—massive—silver-light held high—beacon—giant-eyes turned—watched—silent decision. Fragmented legion—cave-collapsing—Igigi descending—giant-kind—divided—silver-shard glowed—promise? Weapon? Geralt forced neck—up—tearing psychic ice—voice cracked—"Gate…" Chestplate seized—joints locked—armor conserving energy—forcing stillness. Applicator hissed—*Fools… pursue perfection…*. Giants shifted—rubble-fall—knelt?—forming circle—around silver-shard holder—around Geralt—around smoking scar… toward deeper cavern—obsidian cliffs—molten river-fork—flowing… upward? Gravity-defiant. Not water—liquid gold-resonance—new stream? Breached lattice-path? Giant knelt—shard-carrier—plunged silver-light—into molten gold-flow—not sink—fusion—purple-white geyser surged—ceilingwards—portal-flare—raw space-time tear—burning ozone-metallic stench—vortex spinning—Martian dust-glint inside? Cyklus? Giants roared—unified—charging—toward portal-light—toward upward-flow—toward source—not escape… invasion? Thorin gaped—"They… counterattack…?" Borin whispered—dagger-ash mingling gold-sludge—"Old Ways… remembered…" Geralt struggled—armor yielding—inch—vision blurring—portal-vortex—giant-backs—charging—vanishing—into purple-gold tear—last giant paused—portal-edge—looked back—stone-eyes—met Geralt’s—nodded—deep understanding—shared purpose?—then leaped—consumed light. Portal pulsed—unstable—shrinking—drill-screech overhead—metal jaws lowering—darkness fell—save vortex-glimmer—escape? Or death-door? Legion stranded—choice: follow giants… into poisoned stars… or drown below. Geralt’s palm—Luminare flickered—answering vortex-call… pulling… toward light… toward war.
